Discuss your workflow ↗
Why a shared workspace instead of one agent per tab?

A tab is a resource, not a job description. An agent owns a responsibility and acquires a tab when it needs to act. The intended coordinator handles ownership and dependencies so agents can exchange updates without competing for the same browser surface or running an expensive permanent loop for every tab.

What is real in the demo?

The interactions are real page interactions with fictional state. They illustrate a currency decision, a product handoff, an outdated approval and a request for human sign-in. Nothing connects to Shopify, Printify, a domain provider or a model. No external action is performed.

Can I choose the model, cloud and storage?

The direction is model-agnostic and cloud-agnostic, with adapters documented as they are implemented. CockroachDB is the planned durable store for shared task state; the browser-workspace storage contract is not implemented yet. Replication and regional resilience depend on the actual deployment, not the landing page.

Less “who has the tab?”
